finding: The narrowed rebase rule still counts a rebase that replays only commits the Diagnosis branch never made: reset (or fast-forward merge) the branch to another local branch holding a stranger commit, then rebase onto the newer feature tip, and land pushes that commit as the fix. The delta closed the drop-the-fix shape of the same rule but left this sibling shape on the old behaviour.
why: The function's own contract: "Refuse a land with no commit past the Base commit that the Diagnosis branch made" (skills/afk/fix/scripts/ship.py:646); its refusal says land "would ship no fix" (skills/afk/fix/scripts/ship.py:674). The sibling test pins the same intent for a direct rebase onto another branch: test_fast_forward_land_refuses_a_branch_rebased_onto_another_branch_with_no_fix (scripts/tests/test_ship.py:1014).
fix: Count a rebase only when the commits it replayed include one the branch made: walk the reflog oldest-first so `made` holds the earlier entries, and require `git rev-list {onto}..{before}` to intersect `made` in addition to the current not-onto and not-ancestor-of-before checks; add a test that resets to a branch holding a stranger commit, rebases onto a newer feature tip, and expects `refused` with no push and no entry.

finding: When the rebase is the oldest reflog entry, `before` is empty and the new held-before check is skipped, so a rebase that dropped the only fix counts as a fix again: land answers done and lists a push entry for a head with no fix. Everywhere else the function refuses when it cannot tell (no Base commit, Base commit not in the checkout, an empty reflog), so an unknown pre-rebase head fails open only here.
why: skills/afk/fix/scripts/ship.py:650-651 and 655-656 refuse because land "cannot tell whether {d.branch} carries a fix commit"; skills/afk/fix/scripts/ship.py:648 states "a rebase that drops the fix makes nothing".
fix: Treat an unknown pre-rebase head as not proven: replace `before and _git(...).returncode == 0` with `not before or _git(...).returncode == 0` so a rebase with no older reflog line is not counted (a fix commit still counts through its own `commit` entry).

A mutant reading `rows[i + 2]` instead of `rows[i + 1]` in `_carries_a_fix` passes all 15 land tests, and with that mutant land answers `done` (how=found) for a branch whose only fix was dropped.

finding: Possible fragile test: the sequence editor matches only the long `pick` word, so a developer whose global git config sets `rebase.abbreviateCommands=true` gets `p` lines, nothing is dropped, and the test fails at the HEAD == moved check (a false red, not a false pass). Reproduced on WSL Ubuntu git 2.43: `NOT DROPPED: HEAD=d6185620... moved=89748748...`. CI sets no such key, so CI is unaffected.
why: test-veracity checklist, Fragile test: "asserts coupled to shared/seeded data; time/locale/ordering assumptions" — the test leans on the runner's global git config, which the fixture does not isolate.
fix: Pin the todo format in the same call: `git(repo, "-c", "rebase.abbreviateCommands=false", "-c", "sequence.editor=sed -i '2s/^pick/drop/'", "rebase", ...)`, or match either form with `sed -i '2s/^p\(ick\)\{0,1\} /drop /'`.
